en: Vintage colorized postcard showing a panoramic view over a town surrounded by green hills and cultivated fields. Red-roofed houses are scattered in the foreground, while in the center of the town a large church or cathedral with multiple towers is visible. The sky is blue with light clouds. On the top left the word "Pécs" is printed, and on the top right the word "Látkép" appears. The reverse side is an unused divided-back postcard with green printed guidelines for address and stamp.
